articles.title: Older Nest connections need an event migration by November 30
articles.dek: Google will stop sending events through its legacy service; affected Home Assistant setups need a replacement.
body: Home Assistant owners using Nest’s older event connection need to move it into their own Google Cloud project by November 30. Google will stop publishing events to the legacy Google-hosted topics after that date, leaving affected connections without those updates.

Klaas Schoute corrects Home Assistant’s troubleshooting guide, which previously said the old setup worked fine. A topic beginning with projects/sdm-prod/topics identifies the affected arrangement. The guide directs owners to create a topic in their own project, disable the legacy topic and re-enable events with the replacement in the Device Access Console.

articles.title: Music Assistant gathers the latest episodes from your podcasts
articles.dek: A Discover row brings the newest episode of each library podcast into one place.
body: Music Assistant adds a Latest podcast episodes row to Discover, bringing together the newest episode from each podcast in the library. Listeners can see what has arrived without opening every show separately; the row lists the most recent releases first.

The list refreshes every six hours by default, with an option to change the schedule or run it from the Tasks screen. It survives restarts, avoiding a fresh round of feed requests every time Music Assistant starts. OzGav supplies the addition, reviewed by Fabian Munkes.

pullRequests.title: Add a Latest podcast episodes row to the Discover page

articles.title: Assist starts timers in Turkish
articles.dek: New phrases cover hours, minutes and seconds, including half-hour and half-minute requests.
body: Turkish speakers gain Assist commands for starting a timer in hours, minutes or seconds. The new language rules recognize requests such as “10 dakikalık zamanlayıcı kur” for a ten-minute timer, as well as half an hour or half a minute.

Akın Ömeroğlu supplies the phrases and Turkish confirmation messages in his first contribution to the intents repository. This addition covers starting timers with one time unit; combined durations and other timer controls are outside these rules.

pullRequests.title: [tr] Add HassStartTimer sentences for hours, minutes and seconds

articles.title: Assist gains speech transcription through LiteLLM
articles.dek: A selected transcription model turns voice recordings into text, with optional hints for names and phrases.
body: For people using LiteLLM, Home Assistant adds a route for turning spoken Assist requests into text. Setup selects a transcription model and offers optional hints to help it recognize particular names or terms.

The selected backend must support the language and optional parameters; unsupported hints can cause transcription errors. Marcin Juraszek supplies the addition in his first contribution to Home Assistant Core, reviewed by Joost Lekkerkerker.

articles.title: Music Assistant skips services that no longer carry a song
articles.dek: A withdrawn track or album stops drawing repeated failed attempts when another source is linked.
body: Music Assistant stops repeatedly trying a music-service link after that service says it no longer carries a track. It marks the link unavailable and tries another linked source, rather than letting the withdrawn copy keep blocking playback. Album listings use the same approach when a service no longer has the track list.

Marcel van der Veldt keeps those links so they can recover if synchronization or matching finds the item again. A temporary failure, or a different account lacking the item, does not mark the original account’s link unavailable.
articles.continuity: The Plex cleanup reported on September 15 excluded streaming catalogues. This change handles withdrawn service items during playback, without deleting their links.

pullRequests.title: Skip music sources that no longer have a track or album

articles.title: Music Assistant removes a clue to registered usernames
articles.dek: Unknown usernames receive the same password-checking work as known accounts.
body: Music Assistant stops skipping the expensive password check when a sign-in names an account that does not exist. That shortcut made unknown usernames receive a quicker response, offering a clue about which accounts were registered.

Marcel van der Veldt also moves password hashing off the main processing loop and allows only two calculations at once. This avoids briefly blocking the server for each password check and limits the processor work that simultaneous attempts can start.

articles.title: Home Assistant controls Starlink’s alternative to GPS positioning
articles.dek: A configuration switch lets compatible dishes locate themselves using Starlink satellites alone.
body: Home Assistant adds a switch for Starlink’s “Use Starlink positioning exclusively” setting. Turning it on makes the dish determine its location from Starlink satellites without GPS, an option intended for places where jammed or spoofed GPS can disrupt connectivity.

Yaroslav Berezhinskiy tested the setting on a real dish, checking that changes in Home Assistant and the Starlink app stay in step. This is his first contribution to Home Assistant Core, reviewed by Joost Lekkerkerker.

articles.title: Tuya towel warmers gain heating controls in Home Assistant
articles.dek: Compatible devices expose a target temperature, current temperature and child lock.
body: Home Assistant adds heating controls for compatible Tuya towel warmers. Owners can switch heating on or off, set a target temperature and read the current temperature, with a separate child-lock setting.
Ricardo Garcia tested the controls on his own towel warmer. The work includes his first contribution to Home Assistant Core.

articles.title: Music Assistant lets iPhone users choose a separate app language
articles.dek: The iOS settings for the app can override the phone’s system language.
body: Music Assistant’s iPhone app gains its own language choice in iOS Settings. A listener can choose one of the app’s supported languages without changing the phone’s system language, and the change takes effect without restarting the app. David Bishop supplies the addition, reviewed by Andrii Mitnovych.

pullRequests.title: Allow setting the app's language via the app-specific iOS settings app

articles.title: La Marzocco shot timing reaches Home Assistant over Bluetooth
articles.dek: Compatible espresso machines supply brewing status and timing through a more responsive local connection.
body: Home Assistant reads shot timing and brewing status over Bluetooth on compatible La Marzocco espresso machines. Josef Zweck adds a more responsive local connection for those readings, which remain available while the Bluetooth shot counter is active even if the cloud connection has ended.
The connection runs while the machine can brew and stops when it enters standby. Machines must support the Bluetooth shot timer; this does not make every La Marzocco model compatible.

pullRequests.title: Support bluetooth shot timer in lamarzocco

articles.title: Home Assistant explains why sunset automations can miss their action
articles.dek: Checking the Sun entity after a sunset trigger can block the action; dedicated Sun conditions avoid the timing gap.
body: A sunset automation can fire before Home Assistant’s Sun entity changes to below the horizon, causing an added state check to block the action. Updated guidance explains that the entity can lag sunrise and sunset triggers by a few minutes.

The guide points to the dedicated “Sun is set” and “Sun is up” conditions, which change at the same moment as the triggers. The distinction matters for automations such as outdoor lights that combine a sunrise or sunset trigger with a check on the Sun. Sridhar Neti makes his first contribution to Home Assistant’s website with the explanation.

pullRequests.title: Document that the Sun entity state can lag the sunrise and sunset triggers
